node.title: Per-row certified radius extension: multiplier + meet-in-the-middle to weight ~24
node.statement: SIMPLIFIED (post-impossibility): direct meet-in-the-middle MOD P needs NO multiplier — enumerate signed sparse sums of zeta-powers directly, check none vanish beyond the cyclotomic relations; cost ~C(N', w/2) 2^{w/2}, feasible to w ~ 24-30 at N' = 128. Extends the certified radius per row with a printed certificate.
node.notes: FLIP on replay (consolidation agent, verifier replayed): PROVABLE -> PROVED (HONESTY CORRECTION folded in: feasibility ceiling w~20 routine / w~24 with the Galois-orbit reduction; w~30 was aspirational and is withdrawn).
